purpose: Separate language-style pretraining from conversational-format training.

sources.role: Russian prose, correspondence, criticism and verse samples for next-token language modeling.
sources.attribution: Dataset card identifies the collection as CC0; underlying texts are described as public domain.

sources.role: Russian user/assistant turns for conversational formatting and response continuation.

safeguards: Fetch only the public train split; do not mix the external test split into training.
Keep source names, license identifiers, source URLs and filtering steps in every generated manifest.
Do not commit downloaded source text or model checkpoints to the Git repository.
Do not represent a corpus download or a next-token model as evidence of factual reasoning.
The first data-viewer sample is a bounded prototype subset, not the complete upstream dataset.
